title: JetBrains security advisory (AV26-1050)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1050 Date: October 15, 2026 As of October 15, 2026, JetBrains is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Datalore Prior to 2026.2.1 Junie CLI Prior to 26.8.3 TeamCity Prior to 2026.2 Prior to 2026.1.4 Prior to 2025.11.8 YouTrack Prior to 2026.2.19575 Piror to 2026.3.16075 Prior to 2026.3.16397 Prior to 2026.3.16402 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Fixed security issues Security - The JetBrains Blog Article Link: JetBrains security advisory (AV26-1050) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
